entry.title: Annual Town Meeting, May 2, 2026: Lunenburg Water District, 2026-04-22

entry.title: Annual Town Meeting, May 2, 2026: Select Board, 2026-04-21

entry.title: Annual Town Meeting, May 2, 2026: Finance Committee, 2026-02-26

entry.summary: The town will fund TC Pacios building operations through FY27 while winding down user groups, with the goal of not heating it through another winter and a possible decommissioning warrant article next year.

entry.title: Annual Town Meeting, May 2, 2026: Select Board, 2026-02-17

entry.title: Annual Town Meeting, May 2, 2026: Trust Fund Commission, 2026-02-12
entry.summary: Chair scheduled a presentation to the select board for March 3rd covering the bylaw and warrant articles.

entry.title: Annual Town Meeting, May 2, 2026: Open Space Committee, 2026-02-11
entry.summary: The town meeting warrant article will be filed as a placeholder ('establish an open space committee') since final bylaw language can be finalized up until close to the warrant deadline.

entry.title: Annual Town Meeting, May 2, 2026: Select Board, 2026-02-10
entry.summary: Town manager will meet with Mr. Franco Friday to work through senior tax relief warrant article concerns and bring something back to the board.

entry.title: Annual Town Meeting, May 2, 2026: Finance Committee, 2026-02-05

entry.title: Annual Town Meeting, May 2, 2026: Select Board, 2026-02-03
entry.summary: Chair will reach out to the school committee about crafting a joint warrant article on the Kids Kingdom relocation.

entry.title: Annual Town Meeting, May 2, 2026: Trust Fund Commission, 2026-01-29
